output.reason: The release note [ev-23b2de76a2d8] says only that WatchOperation now handles deletes and gained more E2E tests. The CRD validator, backed by [ev-d8a9fd80558b], confirms that ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 WatchOperation exists only in the target release, so nobody upgrading from a previous release had an earlier WatchOperation behaviour that could change. This is a fix made during development of a newly added API, not a behavior-changed relative to the prior release. Adding the API is a separate upstream change, so no corrected assertion follows from this note.
